comment: Efficiency closure of the tag-and-probe (run_tnp.py --closure): data role = every MC sample of the extraction with even original file keys, MC role = the odd ones (each half normalized to its own genEventSumw), both calibrated as MC; in the data role a passed identification of a probe is dropped with probability 1 - keep_id (per flavour and lepton, stream 4 of the object seed), so the true SF_id = SF_full = keep_id and SF_sip = SF_iso = 1.  The fit model is the one of the base configuration (without its bin-specific overrides and exclusions); the bins are coarser than the nominal ones so that the three points run in about an hour; the report point (45 GeV, |eta| 1.2) is interpolated as in the nominal.

bins.comment: Closure bins: probe pT (calibrated) and |eta| (muons) / |eta_SC| (electrons) lower edges, the last bin unbounded.
